#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, m, s;
    long long t;
    cin >> n >> m >> s >> t;
    s--; // decrement as in Java

    while (t % n != 0) {
        if (s < m) {
            s = (int)((s + t) % n);
        } else {
            s = (int)((s - t) % n);
            if (s < 0) s += n;
        }
        t--;
    }
    t /= n;

    vector<int> seen(n, -1);
    seen[s] = 0;
    int count = 0;
    while (t-- > 0) {
        count++;
        int i = n - 1;
        while (i >= 1) {
            if (s < m) {
                s = (s + i) % n;
            } else {
                s = (s - i + n) % n;
            }
            i--;
        }
        if (seen[s] != -1) {
            t %= (count - seen[s]);
        }
        seen[s] = count;
    }
    cout << (s + 1) << endl;
    return 0;
}
